description: Search HackerNews stories, comments, Ask HN, and Show HN posts via the public Algolia API (no key, no login, no browser). Takes a required keyword query and returns structured results with title, URL, author, publish time, points/comment metrics, and type-specific fields. Supports content type filter, relevance or latest-date sorting, and time range filtering; requests above the maxLimit of 1000 are rejected.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: 内容类型：story / comment / ask_hn / show_hn

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: 排序：default（相关性）/ latest（时间倒序）；popular 不支持，会被忽略并标注 ignoredParams

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: 时间范围：day / week / month / year / all
